scientific_integrity: Analytic Schur-Weyl/Laplace proof. Finite computations corroborate but do not establish asymptotics. No independent validation, certified novelty, or dynamic spectral-gap assertion.
scientific_limitations: Equilibrium isotropic mean-field spin-half system only; beta_n=2+t/sqrt(n) with fixed t. Critical-window dynamical gaps, noncommutative simultaneous magnetization measurements, and uniform moving-t limits are not addressed. Quartic critical scaling is established prior art; an uninspected general O(3) result could imply parts of this explicit specialization.
title: A critical-window spin-magnitude and magnetization law for the mean-field quantum Heisenberg ferromagnet
